name: TAMAGOTCHI Keychain Silver
description: A silver keychain inspired by handheld digital toys, finished with a screen-style face, small buttons and a dangling star detail.
fullDescription: The TAMAGOTCHI keychain brings a nostalgic digital-toy reference into the ECHO accessory collection. Its rounded silver body, small front buttons and screen-style face create a miniature handheld silhouette. A key ring and short chain connect the main body to a hanging star detail. The combination of familiar toy-inspired shapes and a silver finish gives this accessory its distinctive character.
